20: std::string normalize_word(std::string_view word) {
21:     std::string normalized;
22:     normalized.reserve(word.size());
23: 
24:     for (unsigned char ch : word) {
25:         if (std::isalnum(ch) != 0) {
26:             normalized.push_back(static_cast<char>(std::tolower(ch)));
27:         }
28:     }
29: 
30:     return normalized;
31: }

33: std::vector<std::string> tokenize(std::string_view text) {
34:     std::vector<std::string> words;
35:     std::istringstream stream{std::string{text}};
36: 
37:     for (std::string raw_word; stream >> raw_word;) {
38:         std::string word = normalize_word(raw_word);
39:         if (!word.empty()) {
40:             words.push_back(std::move(word));
41:         }
42:     }
43: 
44:     return words;
45: }

140: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_and(std::string_view query) const {
141:     std::vector<std::string> words;
142:     std::unordered_set<std::string> seen_words;
143: 
144:     for (std::string& word : tokenize(query)) {
145:         if (seen_words.insert(word).second) {
146:             words.emplace_back(std::move(word));
147:         }
148:     }
149: 
150:     if (words.empty()) {
151:         return std::nullopt;
152:     }
153: 
154:     std::unordered_map<size_t, size_t> book_match_counts;
155: 
156:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
157:         const auto found = inverted_index.find(word);
158:         if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
159:             return std::nullopt;
160:         }
161: 
162:         std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
163:         for (const Index& index : found->second) {
164:             matched_books.emplace(index.book_id);
165:         }
166: 
167:         for (size_t book_id : matched_books) {
168:             book_match_counts[book_id]++;
169:         }
170:     }
171: 
172:     std::unordered_set<size_t> matched_books;
173:     for (const auto& [book_id, count] : book_match_counts) {
174:         if (count == words.size()) {
175:             matched_books.insert(book_id);
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:     if (matched_books.empty()) {
180:         return std::nullopt;
181:     }
182: 
183:     std::vector<Index> matches;
184:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
185:         const auto& indices = inverted_index.at(word);
186: 
187:         for (const Index& index : indices) {
188:             if (matched_books.contains(index.book_id)) {
189:                 matches.push_back(index);
190:             }
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
195: 
196:     return matches;

199: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
200:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
201:     if (words.empty()) {
202:         return std::nullopt;
203:     }
204: 
205:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
206:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
207:         return std::nullopt;
208:     }
209: 
210:     std::vector<Index> matches;
211:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
212:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
213:         bool is_phrase = true;
214: 
215:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
216:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
217:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
218:                 return std::nullopt;
219:             }
220: 
221:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
222:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.chapter_id == start.chapter_id &&
223:                        index.line == start.line && index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
224:             });
225: 
226:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
227:                 is_phrase = false;
228:                 break;
229:             }
230: 
231:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
232:         }
233: 
234:         if (is_phrase) {
235:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
236:         }
237:     }
238: 
239:     if (matches.empty()) {
240:         return std::nullopt;
241:     }
242: 
243:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
244:     return matches;
245: }

249: 
250:     if (nums > word_counts.size()) {
251:         return std::nullopt;
252:     }
253: 
254:     vector<pair<string, size_t>> counts;
255:     counts.reserve(word_counts.size());
256: 
257:     for (const auto& [word, count] : word_counts) {
258:         counts.emplace_back(word, count);

261:     ranges::sort(counts, {}, [](const auto& item) {
262:         return std::pair{static_cast<size_t>(-item.second), item.first};
263:     });

265:     auto words = counts | views::take(nums) |
266:                  views::transform([](auto& item) { return std::move(item.first); }) |
267:                  ranges::to<vector<string>>();

321: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_near(
322:     std::string_view key1, std::string_view key2, size_t dis) const {
323:     const std::string word1 = normalize_word(key1);
324:     const std::string word2 = normalize_word(key2);
325:     if (word1.empty() || word2.empty()) {
326:         return std::nullopt;
327:     }
328: 
329:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(word1);
330:     const auto second_word = inverted_index.find(word2);
331:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end() || second_word == inverted_index.end()) {
332:         return std::nullopt;
333:     }
334: 
335:     std::vector<Index> matches;
336: 
337:     for (const Index& first : first_word->second) {
338:         for (const Index& second : second_word->second) {
339:             if (first.book_id != second.book_id || first.chapter_id != second.chapter_id ||
340:                 first.line != second.line) {
341:                 continue;
342:             }
343: 
344:             const size_t distance = first.word_idx > second.word_idx
345:                                         ? first.word_idx - second.word_idx
346:                                         : second.word_idx - first.word_idx;
347:             if (distance <= dis) {
348:                 matches.push_back(first);
349:                 matches.push_back(second);
350:             }
351:         }
352:     }
353: 
354:     if (matches.empty()) {
355:         return std::nullopt;
356:     }

358:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
359:

363: Context SearchEngine::get_context(const Index& idx) const {
364:     if (idx.book_id >= books.size()) {
365:         return {};
366:     }
367:     const Book& book = books[idx.book_id];
368: 
369:     if (idx.line >= book.lines.size() || is_blank_line(book.lines[idx.line])) {
370:         return {};
371:     }
372:     size_t cur_begin = idx.line;
373: 
374:     while (cur_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_begin - 1])) {
375:         cur_begin--;
376:     }
377: 
378:     size_t cur_end = idx.line + 1;
379:     while (cur_end < book.lines.size() && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_end])) {
380:         cur_end++;
381:     }
382: 
383:     Context context{
384:         .cur = join_lines(book.lines, cur_begin, cur_end),
385:     };
386: 
387:     size_t prev_end = cur_begin;
388:     while (prev_end > 0 && is_blank_line(book.lines[prev_end - 1])) {
389:         --prev_end;

He was waiting for a call from the President of a far distant country, and between wondering when the wretched man would telephone, and trying to suppress unpleasant memories of what had been a very long, tiring, and difficult week, there was not much space in his head for anything else. The more he attempted to focus on the print on the page before him, the more clearly the Prime Minister could see the gloating face of one of his political oppo-nents.
